description: Any wallet's balance of any ERC-20 token (USDC, USDT, DAI, or any contract) via balanceOf, across Base, Ethereum, Optimism, Arbitrum, Polygon, Gnosis. The token-balance read wallet-tracking, copy-trade, treasury and trading agents poll constantly — the most-called RPC read after native balance. Live public RPC; 6 chains vs onesource's Ethereum-only coverage.
name: get_chain_erc20_balance
